Hello,

I am writing about a possible participant for NCT07564414. He is a 61-year-old man with type 2 diabetes who lives in the Sacramento area.

He already meets these criteria: age 18 or older, a type 2 diabetes history with HbA1c 8.4% (below 10%), and no GLP-1 RA or amylin analogue use (his only medication is metformin).

Two items are still open:
1. BMI of at least 35.0 kg/m^2. We have no height or weight on file. We will measure them at a clinic visit.
2. Self-reported weight change of more than 5% in the past 90 days. We will ask the patient directly.

The nearest listed sites (Lincoln, CA, and Walnut Creek, CA) show as active, not recruiting. Can you tell us:
- Which site is nearest and still enrolling, if any?
- What pre-screening steps do you require?

We will send the BMI and weight-change answers once we have them.

Thank you.

patient_summary.en: This study tests two doses of a new weight-loss medicine called CagriSema. It is compared with another medicine, semaglutide. Next, we need to measure your height and weight. We also need to ask if your weight changed a lot in the last three months. We are also asking the study team whether a nearby site is still taking new people. Joining is your choice. You can say no or stop at any time.
